name: Regex and diff
summary: Test regular expressions and compare two texts
author: friday-core
description: Regular expression testing and text comparison. It holds 2 tools and picks the right one from what you ask. Regex tester: Runs a JavaScript regular expression against sample text and returns each match with its position, numbered and named groups and a count, so a pattern is proven rather than guessed. Accepts /pattern/flags on text in one sentence. Stops a pattern that backtracks for too long. Other engines (Python, .NET, PCRE) differ in lookbehind, named groups and flags. Text diff: Compares two texts line by line with a longest-common-subsequence diff and returns a unified-style listing with context lines, counts of added, removed and unchanged lines and a similarity percentage. Can ignore whitespace differences. Takes before and after, or one text split by a line of dashes. Text only, no files.
